title: Lotus Creations
description:
Lotus Creations.
Lotus - The Great Blacksmith and the Lost God.
body:
Texture pack that allows you to change **the model of weapons and armor by name**.\
Текстурпак, который позволяет изменить **модель оружия и брони по названию**.\
To use the texture pack you need the **Sodium mod** and **CIT Resewn**.\
Для использования текстурпака вам ужен мод **Sodium**  и **CIT Resewn**.\
In order to get the **ArmorKnght** set\
You need to rename the entire **iron armor set** to **ArmorKnght**\
**Each piece of armor in ArmorKnght**.\
![ArmorKnght](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/67fce5f26ca3e1109410bcac76f18aa5f6a7b650_0.webp)
![ArmorKnght](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c0e28665e290b201fcbc65ba6b41cb7e2355c258_0.webp)
![ArmorKnght](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cc837d80a64562d00c8da1c42700d8db1828466b_0.webp)
![ArmorKnght](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5167f5b11e947c1db329f320b0ff669d1db865a2_0.webp)
To get **KSLU** you need to rename the **iron sword to KSLU**.\
![KSLU](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/105c0cf29c921dd798170adb7edc4a677de1621a_0.webp)
To get **KnightShield**, you need to rename **the shield to KnightShield**.\
![KnightShield](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9b8d8a5bfef0cb9fa871afde9a9af399fd04769b_0.webp)
To get the **DemonArmor** set, you must rename **each piece of diamond armor**.\
![DemonArmor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/107e601cb9e97a7be790607d19914350a4c1f72b_0.webp)
![DemonArmor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5279f501f34edd93651a7088fcfafdec97eecd99_0.webp)
![DemonArmor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9346502504e235176b5c29df2b9b310bca09f8c9_0.webp)
![DemonArmor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/296969d4e27ac056dcd3b170305ac632d6be5ba5_0.webp)
To get **DieSlave** you must rename **the netherite sword to DieSlave**.\
![DieSlave](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fae95c2bb39e39ac581cd34b90f0e5b12a53dd34_0.webp)
To get **BloodSteelShield**, you must rename **the shield to BloodSteelShield**.\
![BloodSteelShield](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/27efdb00e934cc738b6f272515ced99a982eefcb_0.webp)
To get **DragoArmor**, you must rename **each piece of netherite armor to DragoArmor**.\
![DragoArmor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ab1931e142e697afac2f8045fab2b2d6abb69013_0.webp)
![DragoArmor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f9977b55366907fb3af522f14e1ef14d702c44dd_0.webp)
![DragoArmor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bd017a50a040840ae0b86023ebeae2b6a1bc8fa2_0.webp)
![DragoArmor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/70e5d8f88c68bf1d034dda226f021608c237ce0c_0.webp)
To get **DragonLongSword**, rename the **netherite sword to DragonLongSword**\
![DragonLongSword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8b923c1f14fb3860c972b2151fb92fa6848407c3_0.webp)
To get **DragonSword**, rename **the netherite sword to DragonSword**.\
![DragonSword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3b5990cda3b44ecf1cffd4abe73ca26776849f6e_0.webp)
To get **DragonShield**, rename **the shield to DragonShield**.\
![DragonShield](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a6d0d41e942a9d86ec0fc16d80ae70994949c70_0.webp)
To get **SwampFiend**, rename **the iron sword to SwampFiend**.\
![SwampFiend](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e0ee6979a0ebabcb5587228442e68eaec67864df_0.webp)
To get **WindPiercer**, rename **the diamond sword to WindPiercer**.\
![WindPiercer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/394eec15b51b4aabf02f4b3ce451f59025012d87_0.webp)
To get **SparklingThug**, rename t**he diamond sword to SparklingThug**.\
![SparklingThug](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b1358077d7a84caaf1e53a0e18827c245e557305_0.webp)
To get **RoseThorn**, rename **the diamond sword to RoseThorn**.\
![RoseThorn](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b903c44a07bd60dcf3886fede849aa6872149fab_0.webp)
To get **AzureWave**, rename t**he diamond axe to AzureWave**.\
![AzureWave](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ab9c8bcbb4e653c4291af42a53659de342ff87a3_0.webp)
To get **Hummer**, rename **the netherite axe to Hummer**.\
![Hummer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/37d8771ff62831ee80001175f4769153698cb935_0.webp)
To get **SpaceCrusher**, rename **the netherite sword to SpaceCrusher**.\
![SpaceCrusher](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7d8e608e3ada8b0ea26059194fec5b51260257a6_0.webp)
Для того чтобы получить сет **ArmorKnght**.\
Нужно переименовать весь сет железной брони в ArmorKnght.\
Каждый элемент брони в ArmorKnght.\
![ArmorKnght](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/67fce5f26ca3e1109410bcac76f18aa5f6a7b650_0.webp)
![ArmorKnght](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c0e28665e290b201fcbc65ba6b41cb7e2355c258_0.webp)
![ArmorKnght](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cc837d80a64562d00c8da1c42700d8db1828466b_0.webp)
![ArmorKnght](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5167f5b11e947c1db329f320b0ff669d1db865a2_0.webp)
Для получения **KSLU** нужно переименовать **железный меч** в KSLU.\
![KSLU](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/105c0cf29c921dd798170adb7edc4a677de1621a_0.webp)
Для получения **KnightShield** нужно переименовать **щит** в KnightShield.\
![KnightShield](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9b8d8a5bfef0cb9fa871afde9a9af399fd04769b_0.webp)
Для получения сета **DemonArmor** нужно переименовать **каждый элемент алмазной брони**.\
![DemonArmor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/107e601cb9e97a7be790607d19914350a4c1f72b_0.webp)
![DemonArmor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5279f501f34edd93651a7088fcfafdec97eecd99_0.webp)
![DemonArmor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9346502504e235176b5c29df2b9b310bca09f8c9_0.webp)
![DemonArmor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/296969d4e27ac056dcd3b170305ac632d6be5ba5_0.webp)
Для получения **DieSlave** нужно переименовать **незеритовый меч** в DieSlave.\
![DieSlave](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fae95c2bb39e39ac581cd34b90f0e5b12a53dd34_0.webp)
Для получения **BloodSteelShield** нужно переименовать **щит** в BloodSteelShield.\
![BloodSteelShield](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/27efdb00e934cc738b6f272515ced99a982eefcb_0.webp)
Для получения **DragoArmor**, нужно переименовать **каждый элемент незеритовой брони** в DragoArmor.\
![DragoArmor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ab1931e142e697afac2f8045fab2b2d6abb69013_0.webp)
![DragoArmor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f9977b55366907fb3af522f14e1ef14d702c44dd_0.webp)
![DragoArmor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bd017a50a040840ae0b86023ebeae2b6a1bc8fa2_0.webp)
![DragoArmor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/70e5d8f88c68bf1d034dda226f021608c237ce0c_0.webp)
Для получения **DragonLongSword** переименуйте **незеритовый меч** в DragonLongSword.\
![DragonLongSword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8b923c1f14fb3860c972b2151fb92fa6848407c3_0.webp)
Для получения **DragonSword** переименуйте **незеритовый меч** в DragonSword.\
![DragonSword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3b5990cda3b44ecf1cffd4abe73ca26776849f6e_0.webp)
Для получения **DragonShield** переименуйте **щит** в DragonShield.\
![DragonShield](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a6d0d41e942a9d86ec0fc16d80ae70994949c70_0.webp)
Для получения **SwampFiend** переименуйте **железный меч** в SwampFiend.\
![SwampFiend](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e0ee6979a0ebabcb5587228442e68eaec67864df_0.webp)
Для получения **WindPiercer** переименуйте **алмазный меч** в WindPiercer.\
![WindPiercer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/394eec15b51b4aabf02f4b3ce451f59025012d87_0.webp)
Для получения **SparklingThug** переименуйте **алмазный меч** в SparklingThug.\
![SparklingThug](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b1358077d7a84caaf1e53a0e18827c245e557305_0.webp)
Для получения **RoseThorn** переименуйте **алмазный меч** в RoseThorn.\
![RoseThorn](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b903c44a07bd60dcf3886fede849aa6872149fab_0.webp)
Для получения **AzureWave** переименуйте **алмазный топор** в AzureWave.\
![AzureWave](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ab9c8bcbb4e653c4291af42a53659de342ff87a3_0.webp)
Для получения **Hummer** переименуйте **незеритовый топор** в Hummer.\
![Hummer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/37d8771ff62831ee80001175f4769153698cb935_0.webp)
Для получения **SpaceCrusher** переименуйте **незеритовый меч** в SpaceCrusher.
![SpaceCrusher](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7d8e608e3ada8b0ea26059194fec5b51260257a6_0.webp)
